subject: Chemistry
q: At physiological temperature T, a biochemical reaction proceeds 10⁶ times faster with an enzyme than without it. Assuming the pre-exponential factor is unchanged, what is the change in activation energy when the enzyme is added?
hint: Take the ratio of the two Arrhenius rate constants at the same temperature.
solution: From k = A exp(-Ea/RT), k_enzyme/k_without = exp[(Ea,without - Ea,enzyme)/RT] = 10⁶. Thus Ea,enzyme - Ea,without = -RT ln(10⁶) = -6RT ln 10 = -6(2.303)RT.
